description: Cancels a booking at the customer's explicit request. Requests not yet confirmed by the driver and unpaid tours are cancelled at once (the customer gets an email). Confirmed or paid bookings are passed to the business as a cancellation request, which it handles under the Terms (free until 24 hours before transfers, 48 hours before tours). Needs the bookingId and the customer's email. Ask the customer to confirm before calling.

email.description: The customer's email address used for the booking (proves it is their booking).

name: cancel_booking
title: Cancel a booking
